evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive issued in the present to erase specific named artifacts (fleet, contracts); the command itself is irrealis — a desired state-change, not a report of fact.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Present-tense directive targeting a category of knowledge (routes in general) rather than a specific artifact; the command is irrealis — a desired erasure, not a settled fact.
